name: US Growth Hunt
description: A bucketed research universe that balances AI infrastructure, cloud/data, security platforms, and emerging application software so the system can compare crowded megacaps against higher-upside mid-cap candidates.

buckets.label: AI Infra Core
buckets.rationale: Keep the unavoidable AI infrastructure leaders in view, but treat them as benchmarks rather than automatic top picks.

buckets.label: Cloud & Data Platforms
buckets.rationale: Look for platforms where AI demand can translate into durable revenue acceleration instead of one-off narrative spikes.

buckets.label: Security Platforms
buckets.rationale: Security names can compound through platform expansion and often offer better odds than the most crowded AI hardware trades.

buckets.label: Emerging App Software
buckets.rationale: Add a smaller bucket of high-velocity application software names that may still be under-owned relative to their growth runway.
